expected_source: the printed value comes from building the identical C sources with an independent host C compiler (cc -std=gnu99, identical at -O0/-O1/-O2/-Os); the RTS exit path ends in abort(), which takes no argument, so the final A4 is unspecified and only the CIO text is checked; the host build defines _LITTLE_ENDIAN, which the TI compiler defines for this target and which the FFT kernels use to select their twiddle-factor convention
